To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have designed, fabricated and characterized a free standing micordisk with a high Q of 7.21×10<sup><sup>4</SUP></SUP></sup> at 1310nm, which is the highest value reported to date in a micordisk of such a small diameter.

we have developed a low temperature fabrication process that can be used to fabricate high Q silicon nitride disk resonators with vertical coupling, and that the quality factor of the resonator is limited by the material absorption.
the high-q free-standing silicon micordisk is vertically coupled to an on-chip waveguides with low loss and high coupling efficiency.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fabrication of high quality factor silicon nitride disk resonator with low temperature process and its application in on-chip waveguides.
the design and fabrication of high-Q microdisk resonators vertically coupled to a silicon waveguide.
the development of high-Q microcavity devices that are compatible with integrated optical circuits.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this paper presents the design, simulation, fabrication and measurement of a high-Q free-standing micodisk vertically coupled to a waveguide with an intrinsic quality factor up to 7.2 × 10<sup> 4</sup> at 1310 nm wavelength, with only 15 μm radius, which is the smallest radius of micodisk reported in the literature.
this paper presents the design and fabrication of high-Q micordisks coupled with an on-chip waveguides.
the high-q silicon nitride micorods can be used for high performance on-chip photonic devices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the quality factor is improved by a factor of 2.3 in the same disk with the same radius as the previous work.

we have successfully demonstrated the first free-standing silicon nitrides micordisk vertically integrated with a waveguide at a low temperature, which is a key step for realizing high quality factor micordisk devices on a chip.
we demonstrated a high-Q free-standing silicon nitrides microdisk with vertical coupling.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the high quality factor can be obtained with a small disk radius.
we have successfully demonstrated that the high-Q silicon nitride microdisk can be vertically coupled with an on-chip waveguides with low loss.
the vertical coupling structure is a promising candidate for the integration of high-q silicon nitride microdisk devices with on-chip optical circuits.
